0.description: 0px — Flush corners and collapsed gaps. Theme: radius/none, spacing/pad-none, spacing/gap-none.

2.description: 2px — Emphasis stroke; barely softened corners. Theme: border/emphasis, radius/extra-small.

4.description: 4px — Ultra-tight gap; small radius; micro size. Theme: spacing/gap-ultra-tight, radius/small, size/sm/4.

8.description: 8px — Tight gap; pad-v-xs / pad-h-xs; medium radius; compact size. Theme: spacing/gap-tight, spacing/pad-v-xs, spacing/pad-h-xs, radius/medium, size/sm/8.

12.description: 12px — Pad-v-sm / pad-h-sm; large radius; compact icon slot. Theme: spacing/pad-v-sm, spacing/pad-h-sm, radius/large, size/sm/12.

16.description: 16px — Gap-wide; pad-v-md / pad-h-md; standard icon slot. Theme: spacing/gap-wide, spacing/pad-v-md, spacing/pad-h-md, size/md/16.

24.description: 24px — Gap-loose; pad-v-lg / pad-h-lg; compact control height. Theme: spacing/gap-loose, spacing/pad-v-lg, spacing/pad-h-lg, size/md/24.

28.description: 28px — Between compact and standard control. Theme: size/md/28 (buttongroup, calendar, stepper).

32.description: 32px — Gap-ultraloose; pad-v-xl / pad-h-xl; default control height. Theme: spacing/gap-ultraloose, spacing/pad-v-xl, spacing/pad-h-xl, size/md/32.

36.description: 36px — Optgroup row height. Core only — no theme size role.

40.description: 40px — Large control / toolbar row. Theme: size/lg/40.

44.description: 44px — Presence indicator. Core only — no theme size role.

48.description: 48px — Avatar / spinner mid-scale. Core only — not in size grouping.

52.description: 52px — Wide control minimum (input min-width). Theme: size/lg/52.

64.description: 64px — Chrome band: header, searchfield, avatar lg. Theme: size/lg/64.

full.description: True circle. Theme: radius/full. Figma FLOAT cannot store %.
